stories.title: Great Alaska Shootout provides rare opportunities to UAA and visiting Louisville
stories.summary: The Seawolves lost 113-40 on Saturday, but just getting to play against a nationally ranked Division I opponent was a valuable experience.

stories.title: U.S. probing alleged spy tied to ex-Nvidia CEO, spy chief says
stories.summary: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said Nvidia Corp. is a perpetual target for people trying to illegally obtain its high-end chips and the U.S. is investigating an alleged Chinese spy who had an affair with the company’s former chief executive.

stories.title: Tarik Skubal agrees to record $450 million, 9-year contract with New York Mets, AP source says
stories.summary: Skubal was the top free agent on this offseason’s market. His reported deal is the largest for a pitcher by total value and by average salary at $50 million per year.

stories.title: Automation system problem at Delta causes flight delays as Americans travel for Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Over a thousand Delta Air Lines flights were experiencing delays early Sunday evening following a problem with an automation system during a busy time for travel ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday.

stories.title: The remarkable recovery of a National Guardsman shot near the White House
stories.summary: A year after Staff Sgt. Andrew Wolfe was shot in the head, his mind and body are healing. But his life was turned upside down.

stories.title: Officials, passengers ‘outraged’ by ICE ambush at Sea-Tac as passengers boarded Alaska Airlines plane
stories.summary: One video shows passengers asking for and recording the name of a detained woman, who was dragged by agents out of the jetway, wailing and sobbing after her father was detained.

stories.title: Not just any restaurant but The Restaurant, which was really another restaurant in disguise
stories.summary: Based on Seattle-based eatery 13 Coins, hungry customers seeking out The Restaurant in Anchorage were often confused trying to access the sign-free building.

stories.title: North Slope Borough sues state to stop planned expansion of tax break for oil firms
stories.summary: Local governments and a state legislator say the Alaska Department of Revenue didn’t alert them to the proposed change, which is moving quickly, with short notice.

stories.title: Trump keeps losing in court. Here’s how he gets what he wants anyway.
stories.summary: Judges have been unable to slow or stop some of the administration’s highest-profile projects.

stories.title: A California billionaire tax proposal faced a major setback despite big wins for progressives
stories.summary: Voters in California and other states didn’t completely repudiate the concept of taxing the wealthy at higher rates.

stories.title: Tom Jackson, Broncos star and ESPN ‘Sunday NFL Countdown’ analyst, dead at 75
stories.summary: His family asked that his death not be announced until the start of the network’s “Sunday NFL Countdown” show by Jackson’s longtime friend and on-air partner Chris Berman.

stories.title: Democrats clinch a historic House majority of at least 258 seats, the largest since 1992
stories.summary: Emboldened Democrats are preparing a robust agenda to address high costs of living. They’re also planning to confront President Donald Trump, his administration and the corporate community with a vast oversight agenda.
